ConnectionStrings._comment: Default points at LocalDB (ships with Visual Studio) so `dotnet run` works with zero setup. To use a full SQL Server instance instead (e.g. one you manage in SSMS), replace this with something like: 'Server=localhost\SQLEXPRESS;Database=TripSplitDb;Trusted_Connection=True;TrustServerCertificate=True;' or, for SQL auth, 'Server=YOUR_SERVER;Database=TripSplitDb;User Id=YOUR_USER;Password=YOUR_PASSWORD;TrustServerCertificate=True;'
